hurtboxNotes: BOSS_PIPELINE §8.8 (documented, gameplay NOT changed; verified on the --debug pose sheet): mounted = knight box + horse-barrel box; the knight box covers the painted torso, the horse box the painted barrel, the painted chest and rump reach ~25 px past the horse box (vector ~15 px); head, neck, legs and tail have no hurtbox (as in the vector). On foot the single box fits the knight closely; cape and held skull stick out behind. The painted lance is drawn on the logic lance line b + dir*(170+lanceX) from the logic lance base, so charge/thrust/lunge hitboxes and the drawn lance always coincide; the painted blade reaches 24 units past lanceTip() (the vector drew 34).
note: lps = logic units x 1.3 (the mounted draw scale S); the renderer draws parts at k/1.3 inside the S-scaled local frame. Horse body and skull face LEFT in the source (mirrored at runtime), everything else faces right.
